title: 第7章 我想当宰相就是为了逼女帝叫爸爸第8章 女帝过得苦只怪她是二百五
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
;;
“无他，皆是仙人点化！”
听到这个答案，神霄下意识蹙眉。
她的内心之中，倏然升起一种沈浪是神棍的既视感。
毕竟，传闻中受到仙人点化的天命之子，哪个不是一身正气？
但沈浪怎么跟个小流氓似的？
于是，觉得沈浪有些不靠谱的神霄，也是忍不住的追问道：
“北冥书院的夫子，可是咱们大乾王朝学问最高的存在。”
“你确定你写的字帖，能让夫子高看你一眼？”
遭到质疑。
沈浪的脸上浮现出了不悦的神色：“没有被仙人点化之前，或许他是大乾王朝最有学问的！”
“但现在，我只需要略微出手，他就得跪下来，尊称我为先生！”
“明白否？”
神霄：“……”
她这辈子见过能装的，还真的没见过比沈浪还能装的。
还特么只需要略微出手，便能让北冥书院的夫子，跪下来给他喊先生？
这种事，就算是那个所谓的元始天尊来了，恐怕也做不到吧？
就在神霄怀疑，自己是不是被沈浪给忽悠了的时候……
上官冉也拿着笔墨纸砚，走了出来。
委屈巴巴道：“小姐，笔墨纸砚拿来了！”

听到这话。
神霄觉得光靠自己在这里胡猜沈浪的潜力到底有多高，着实自寻烦恼。
还不如，让沈浪出手，看看他到底有什么本事！
于是，神霄立刻从上官冉的手中接过笔墨纸砚。
笑着帮沈浪把纸张铺好：“相公，请开始你的表演！”
眼见神霄把毛笔都递过来了，沈浪也是故作高深的点了点头。
但下一瞬。
发现神霄只顾着看自己。
也是不悦的提醒道：“我提笔，必须得有美人研墨！”
神霄：“……”
上官冉：“装神弄鬼！”
说着，上官冉便打算帮沈浪研墨。
但她刚走一步，沈浪便是厉声爆喝：“我说的是美人，你特么上来干什么？”
“滚一边去！”
“小姐！！！”上官冉握紧了拳头。
神霄也没有想到，沈浪竟然还打算让她研墨。
也下意识的握紧了拳头，想要把沈浪吊起来打。
但想到，沈浪是否有真才实学，马上就能试出来了。
神霄也是强行在心底安抚自己：“就一会，一会就好了！”

"Without him, it's all enlightenment from the immortals!"
Hearing this answer, Shen Xiao frowned subconsciously.
In her heart, she suddenly felt that Shen Lang was a master.
After all, among the sons of destiny who are rumored to be enlightened by immortals, which one is not upright?
But why does Shen Lang act like a hooligan?
Therefore, Shen Xiao, who felt that Shen Lang was a bit unreliable, couldn't help but ask:
"The master of Beiming Academy is the most knowledgeable person in our Daqian Dynasty."
"Are you sure that the copybook you wrote will make the Master look at you favorably?"
was questioned.
A displeased look appeared on Shen Lang's face: "Before he was enlightened by the immortal, perhaps he was the most knowledgeable person in the Daqian Dynasty!"
"But now, I only need to make a slight move, and he has to kneel down and call me sir!"
"Do you understand?"
Shen Xiao: "..."
She has seen people who can pretend in her life, and she really has never seen anyone who can pretend better than Shen Lang.
How the hell could he make the master of Beiming Academy kneel down and call him sir with just a few moves?
Even if the so-called Yuanshi Tianzun comes, I'm afraid he can't do this kind of thing, right?
Just when Shen Xiao was wondering if she had been deceived by Shen Lang...
Shangguan Ran also walked out with pen, ink, paper and inkstone.
He said aggrievedly: "Miss, here are the pens, ink, paper and inkstones!"
Hear this.
Shen Xiao felt that just relying on himself to guess how high Shen Lang's potential was was really asking for trouble.
It's better to let Shen Lang take action and see what he is capable of!
So, Shen Xiao immediately took the pen, ink, paper and inkstone from Shangguan Ran's hand.
Smiling, he helped Shen Lang lay out the paper: "Mr. Sir, please start your performance!"
Seeing Shen Xiao handing over the brushes, Shen Lang nodded pretending to be profound.
But the next moment.
He found that Shen Xiao was only looking at him.
He also reminded him displeasedly: "When I pick up the pen, there must be a beauty who can grind the ink!"
Shen Xiao: "..."
Shangguan Ran: "Pretend to be a ghost!"
With that said, Shangguan Ran planned to help Shen Lang practice ink.
But as soon as she took a step, Shen Lang shouted sharply: "I'm talking about beauty, what are you doing here?"
"Get out of here!"
"Miss!!!" Shangguan Ran clenched his fists.
Shen Xiao also didn't expect that Shen Lang actually planned to let her study ink.
He also clenched his fists subconsciously, wanting to hang Shen Lang up and beat him.
But I thought that whether Shen Lang had real talent or knowledge, he would be able to test it out soon.
Shen Xiao also forced himself to comfort himself in his heart: "Just a moment, it will be fine in a moment!"
